title: empty dashboard invites a first task
description: An empty list shows the first-task prompt and a total of zero.

title: submitting a task displays it in the list
description: Submitting a task name adds that task to the visible list.

title: task names are trimmed and internal whitespace is collapsed
description: Leading and trailing spaces are removed and runs of whitespace become one space.

title: a blank task name is rejected
description: Submitting only whitespace creates no task and shows a validation message.

title: an 80 character name is accepted
description: A task name at the maximum allowed length is saved and displayed.

title: a name longer than 80 characters is rejected
description: A task name over the length limit creates no task.

title: selected category appears on the task
description: The chosen category is shown in the new task's details.

title: selected priority appears on the task
description: The chosen priority is shown on the new task.

title: selected due date appears on the task
description: The chosen due date is shown on the new task.

title: each submitted task has a distinct identifier
description: Consecutive submissions receive different task IDs.

title: Active filter hides completed tasks
description: The Active view shows unfinished tasks and hides completed ones.

title: Completed filter hides active tasks
description: The Completed view shows finished tasks and hides active ones.

title: All filter restores every task
description: Returning to All shows both active and completed tasks.

title: selected status filter exposes pressed state
description: Status filter buttons expose the selected state through aria-pressed.

title: search finds a task by its title
description: Searching for text in a title shows the matching task.

title: search finds a task by category
description: Searching for a category shows tasks in that category.

title: search ignores letter case
description: Search results are the same regardless of query capitalization.

title: an unmatched search shows a filter-specific empty message
description: A query with no matches shows the no-results message instead of the first-task prompt.

title: priority filter selects only matching tasks
description: Choosing a priority hides tasks with other priorities.

title: status search and priority filters combine
description: Status, text search, and priority constraints narrow the list together.

title: Escape cancels an inline edit
description: Pressing Escape closes the editor without changing the task name.

title: Cancel button leaves a task name alone
description: Clicking Cancel discards an unsaved task name edit.

title: Delete removes the selected task
description: Deleting a task removes its row and updates the total count.

title: Delete preserves other tasks
description: Deleting one task leaves unrelated tasks in the list.

title: Clear completed is disabled with no completed tasks
description: The clear action is unavailable when there is nothing completed to clear.

title: Clear completed removes finished tasks
description: The clear action removes completed tasks and updates the completed count.

title: Clear completed preserves active tasks
description: The clear action leaves unfinished tasks in place.

title: deleting the last task restores the empty message
description: Removing the final task restores the first-task prompt.

title: sample button adds three distinct tasks
description: Loading samples adds three different tasks to the list.

title: tasks persist when the page is mounted again
description: Saved tasks appear when a new page instance loads the stored data.

title: checking a task marks it complete
description: Checking a task updates its checkbox and completed styling.

title: checking a completed task makes it active again
description: Checking a finished task again returns it to active state.

title: completion updates active and completed counts
description: Finishing a task moves one count from active to completed.

title: past due active tasks are counted overdue
description: An unfinished task due before today gets an overdue label and count.

title: a task due today is not overdue
description: A task due today does not increase the overdue count.

title: completing an overdue task removes it from the overdue count
description: Finishing an overdue task clears it from the overdue total.

title: edit button opens an inline text field
description: The Edit action reveals a text field containing the current name.

title: saving an edited name updates the visible task
description: Saving a new name updates the task shown on the page.

title: saving a blank edited name preserves the original
description: A blank edit is rejected and the existing task name remains saved.

title: Enter saves an inline edit
description: Pressing Enter in the editor saves the changed task name.

title: newest tasks appear first by default
description: The default order places the most recently added task first.

title: oldest sort puts the first task first
description: Oldest order places the earliest added task first.

title: title sort is alphabetical
description: Title order sorts task names alphabetically.

title: due date sort puts the earliest date first
description: Due date order places the soonest dated task first.

title: due date sort puts undated tasks last
description: Tasks without a due date follow dated tasks in due date order.

title: priority sort orders high medium then low
description: Priority order shows high, then medium, then low priority tasks.

title: theme button switches between light and dark
description: The theme control switches the page to dark mode and back.

title: theme choice persists across a new page mount
description: A new page instance restores the previously chosen theme.

title: exported JSON can restore a deleted task
description: Exported task data can be imported to restore a removed task.

title: invalid imported JSON leaves existing tasks intact
description: A malformed import is rejected without replacing saved tasks.
